title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Viola-specific use contrast in full f9v reading
summary: A historical source that identifies Viola and contrasts its preparation or indication with a named neighboring herb would supply a directional predicate, beyond generic medicinal use. Freeze source ownership and both sides of the contrast first. The complete target reading must assign the right plants, preparation and exception; a generic virtue or cure word cannot satisfy the contrast. No source or Voynich correspondence is yet established.

design.mechanism: A named Viola owner participates in a source-written asymmetric medicinal comparison.
design.unit: Complete source comparison and complete admitted target paragraphs of both proposed plant owners.
design.contrast: direction-preserving use and exception versus broad shared herbal vocabulary
design.prediction: With fochor frozen as the Viola owner, the target reading recovers which herb receives which preparation or indication, including any explicit exception; swapped or undifferentiated roles fail.
design.scope: Raw idea with unknown primary source, second owner, and target capacity.
